quest.title: Equilibrium
quest.description: After arriving at the Guizhong Ballista on Mt. Tianheng, you are surprised to meet another member of the Qixing there. Her name is Keqing, and she gives you detailed instructions on how to ascend to the Jade Chamber. Paimon, however, is preoccupied with another detail that Keqing mentioned: the custom of bringing a greeting gift.
quest.rewards_formatted: Adventure EXP x725, Primogem x30, Mora x29400, Hero's Wit x3, Mystic Enhancement Ore x5

talks.objective: Look for the ingredients Paimon needs

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Huh? Is it just Paimon, or is there a sweet fragrance in the air...?

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Huh... Did you hear that?

choices.text: It sounded like someone calling for help.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: It seemed like it came from those ruins over there...

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Uh oh, it looks like the Treasure Hoarders have locked someone inside.

choices.text: It sounded like someone was singing.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Uh, no! That was definitely someone in trouble! It came from those ruins over there...

talks.objective: Rescue the person in the cage
Talk to the person in the cage

dialogues.speaker: Meng Dan
dialogues.text: Phew... Thank you for your help, kind travelers. If you hadn't come to my aid, I surely would have rotted in this cell! Those Treasure Hoarders... when their mood was good, they'd rearrange those pots of Sweet Flowers. But when they were in a bad mood, they'd rearrange my face...

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Aw, it was nothing. No need to thank us all at once or anything!

dialogues.speaker: Meng Dan
dialogues.text: Haha, I understand. Don't worry, I will compensate you both.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: There's really no need.

dialogues.speaker: Meng Dan
dialogues.text: Don't say that! I only escaped this predicament because of you.

dialogues.speaker: Meng Dan
dialogues.text: I'm Meng Dan, a supplier for Mingxing Jewelry in Liyue Harbor. I often walk around these mountains in search of antiques.

dialogues.speaker: Meng Dan
dialogues.text: I never expected that those Treasure Hoarders would have their eyes on the same ruins that I had. Before I knew it, they'd caught and imprisoned me.

dialogues.speaker: Meng Dan
dialogues.text: Is there anything that you lack? Antiques, treasure, various knick-knacks, you name it! Well, as long as you want what I have to offer, of course.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Your goodwill is good enough for me.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Wait a moment! Actually, we are looking for something!

dialogues.speaker: Meng Dan
dialogues.text: Oh? And what might that be?

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Do you have a box that can store presents? We'd like a pretty one... the kind that you can use to store snacks.

dialogues.speaker: Meng Dan
dialogues.text: Of course we do — how can one sell antiques without gift boxes? At <color=#00E1FFFF>Mingxing Jewelry</color>, we have the best gift-wrapping service in the seven nations.

dialogues.speaker: Meng Dan
dialogues.text: Now, just give me a moment, and I'll let the boss know. You can go see her whenever you require that box.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Great! Paimon's Sugar-Frosted Slime now comes in a beautiful package!

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Hey there! A guy called Meng Dan told us that we could get a nice and shiny box from your store...

dialogues.speaker: Xingxi
dialogues.text: Uncle Meng already told me about it. Thank you both for saving him.

dialogues.speaker: Xingxi
dialogues.text: Many of the best goods in our store were found by Uncle Meng. If anything were to happen to him, it would be impossible for us to continue doing business.

dialogues.speaker: Xingxi
dialogues.text: Here, this container is itself an antique, with at least 140 years of history. It's already been cleaned... Will it do?

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Yup-yup-yup! It's great!

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Hang on a moment. Could we borrow one other thing?

dialogues.speaker: Xingxi
dialogues.text: Sure, please help yourselves — as long as it's on our shelves.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: #{NICKNAME}, this clay pot looks really awesome!

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: If we use an antique as our mixing bowl, we should be able to make a great snack!

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: It's done! The one and only Sugar-Frosted Slime! Carefully now. Into the box it goes, and dust it over with a bit more powdered sugar...

dialogues.speaker: Xingxi
dialogues.text: Oh yes. You might want to use these two freshly-picked flowers as decorations too.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Woohoo! It looks beautiful!

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: (I'm still not sold on this gift idea...)

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Great! Now that we've put all that we've got into this box, let's go to the Jade Chamber to see Ningguang!

talks.objective: Look for the guide to the Jade Chamber

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: (According to Keqing, this is what we should say...)

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Excuse me, do you sell the moon here?

dialogues.speaker: Bu'yun
dialogues.text: Yes. How many would you like?

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: It is not convenient to speak of numbers here.

dialogues.speaker: Bu'yun
dialogues.text: Ah, well said. Please, use this to ascend to the Chamber... Ah, yes. Speaking of which — are you two the guests that Lady Ningguang has arranged to meet with today?

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Yup!

dialogues.speaker: Bu'yun
dialogues.text: (And yet the code they used was not the one for guests, but for the Yuheng. What's going on here...)

dialogues.speaker: Ningguang
dialogues.text: I've been waiting for you, returnee from Jueyun Karst.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Ah, it's Ningguang!

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Since this is our first meeting, um, we've prepared a gift! Hope you like it?

dialogues.speaker: Ningguang
dialogues.text: Oh, for me? You have my thanks. It seems that I have made things difficult for you, considering that you were supposed to be my guests.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Hehe... Oh no, it's nothing.

response.speaker: Ningguang
response.text: Haha. I'm glad you like it too.

response.speaker: Ningguang
response.text: This palace floats in the skies, higher than the peak of any mountain. From this vantage point, one may survey all of Liyue.

response.speaker: Ningguang
response.text: I have been gathering the funds necessary to build it from the time I began learning the merchant's craft. And since becoming the Tianquan, I have spared no effort in hiring the best craftsmen to constantly extend it...

response.speaker: Ningguang
response.text: At first, it was but the size of one room. Now, it is large enough to blot out the moon in the skies above Liyue.

response.speaker: Ningguang
response.text: One day, I believe it will overshadow all seven nations.

response.speaker: Player
response.text: (This Tianquan does not lack for ambition...)

response.speaker: Ningguang
response.text: Not many from outside Liyue earn the right to ascend to the Jade Chamber. But I have been in correspondence with the Acting Grand Master of the Knights of Favonius, who spoke highly of you.

response.speaker: Ningguang
response.text: As such, I have been putting eyes and ears out ever since you reached Liyue...

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: What!?

response.speaker: Ningguang
response.text: And I finally got wind of your movements when you were on the way to Wangshu Inn.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: ...Wait. Was Verr Goldet one of your people!?

response.speaker: Ningguang
response.text: Just Verr Goldet? ...No.

response.speaker: Ningguang
response.text: Everyone at Wangshu Inn is one of ours.

response.speaker: Player
response.text: We also ran into the Yuheng not long ago...

response.speaker: Ningguang
response.text: At the Guizhong Ballista, yes?

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Uh... you weren't peeking on us from the skies the whole time... were you!?

response.speaker: Ningguang
response.text: Haha... I fear that peeking would have been a little difficult from this altitude.

response.speaker: Ningguang
response.text: Our eyes and ears are more than sufficient. You two are very interesting people, after all. It would be natural to take an interest.

response.speaker: Player
response.text: Keqing said that the Qixing would not wish ill on Rex Lapis.

response.speaker: Ningguang
response.text: Well, I wouldn't expect you to trust us, considering that you have had far more interactions with the adepti. The reason I invited you here was to clear up some misunderstandings.

choices.text: It's my first time coming to a place this high up...

dialogues.speaker: Ningguang
dialogues.text: I believe that you've heard of the Archon War?

response.speaker: Ningguang
response.text: Many gods used to walk this earth, and many long wars were fought between them that did not abate until 2,000 years ago. Much blood was shed, and many lives were lost.

response.speaker: Ningguang
response.text: In the end, only seven victors remained standing in Teyvat. They built cities and nations on the corpses of the vanquished, and thus began the era of The Seven.

response.speaker: Ningguang
response.text: You can see Guyun Stone Forest from here, I trust? It is no natural rock formation — those are giant spears of rock, hurled by Rex Lapis during the war.

response.speaker: Ningguang
response.text: Beneath the spears lie those cast down by Rex Lapis in those days: gods that failed to seize the title of Archon.

response.speaker: Ningguang
response.text: Not only is it true that gods may die, but so too has the membership of the Seven changed over the last two millennia. Rex Lapis' passing is an unimaginable disaster for Liyue, but the order of The Seven will not collapse simply because of that.

response.speaker: Ningguang
response.text: Another Lord of Geo will arise sooner or later, yet how are we to forget Rex Lapis? When that time comes, the relationship between the people of Liyue and the gods and adepti will surely be different from before.

response.speaker: Ningguang
response.text: Even in a new era, the Liyue Qixing remain Rex Lapis' former subjects... Do you really think us capable of having played a part in his demise? Of lacking the foresight to see the certain repercussions?

response.speaker: Player
response.text: Why hide the Exuvia, then?

response.speaker: Ningguang
response.text: Heh...

response.speaker: Ningguang
response.text: That day at Yujing Terrace — it was all so very sudden. Even I was caught completely off guard. You were there, you no doubt saw.

response.speaker: Ningguang
response.text: But our enemy has long lain hidden within the harbor. If we do not act against them now, they will surely gain the upper hand.

response.speaker: Ningguang
response.text: Hiding the Exuvia was a necessary maneuver to take the initiative back, to play the spider while our foes scurry about.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Who's this "enemy" you're talking about?

response.speaker: Ningguang
response.text: What do you think, Traveler?

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Eh? What are you two talking about?

response.speaker: Ningguang
response.text: Well answered.

response.speaker: Ningguang
response.text: Hah... The scenery out here is fine indeed, but the wind is a little strong. Our preparations to receive guests within are complete — so please, this way.

choices.text: Only in the broadest of strokes.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Wowee! What a huge hall! Paimon's never seen such a fancy place before...

dialogues.speaker: Ningguang
dialogues.text: Be at ease, you two. Make yourselves at home if you wish.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Can we really!?

dialogues.speaker: Ningguang
dialogues.text: I have invited you two here as friends. And when friends come over to play, our enjoyment comes first, naturally.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Is that what I think it is...?

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Ooh! Isn't this that legendary wall?

dialogues.speaker: Ningguang
dialogues.text: Why, you've kept your ear to the ground, I see.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: That's because even the storytellers are talking about it... Everyone's after a piece of paper from that wall. It's super famous!

dialogues.speaker: Ningguang
dialogues.text: That's because that wall records Liyue's secrets. Merchants have always been attracted to secrets.

dialogues.speaker: Ningguang
dialogues.text: But the secrets of the mercantile world are of no interest to you, are they, Traveler? You're rather special, really — and I think you're quite aware of that.

dialogues.speaker: Ningguang
dialogues.text: If possible, I'd like to have your trust.

dialogues.speaker: Ningguang
dialogues.text: But if you were to choose the more trustworthy person between myself and Keqing...

choices.text: Well, between your orthodoxy and her heterodoxy...

response.speaker: Ningguang
response.text: Haha... You'd pick Keqing? I had a feeling.

response.speaker: Ningguang
response.text: I originally thought her a bit too... hard-headed. With someone of her character on the Qixing, I've had some extra messes to clean up behind the scenes.

response.speaker: Ningguang
response.text: But after she said those words: "The time of the adepti has long passed. If even the Liyue Qixing don't want to face that truth, then what future is there for Liyue..."

response.speaker: Ningguang
response.text: Well, I must say that quite a few of my doubts have been dispelled.

response.speaker: Ningguang
response.text: I won't deny that Rex Lapis' passing seems advantageous to us. But for Liyue's sake, we cannot allow ourselves to be shackled by rumors of our usurpation of power.

response.speaker: Player
response.text: I surmise that the Fatui has a hand in these rumors?

response.speaker: Ningguang
response.text: Indeed... It seems that you understood what I meant to say from the very beginning.

response.speaker: Ningguang
response.text: I called for the gag order and for the Exuvia to be hidden to temporarily stabilize the situation, and also to prevent something similar to the incident in Mondstadt.

response.speaker: Ningguang
response.text: With Rex Lapis' death, the Fatui have busied themselves with many clandestine actions beyond their diplomatic remit. As the Tianquan, one responsible for Liyue, I cannot be too concerned with appearances when opposing them.

response.speaker: Ningguang
response.text: Allowing the Rite of Parting to take place was also meant to buy some time for us to take control of Liyue's administration...

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Ugh... It's exactly as Zhongli said. The Qixing only provided the venue for the rite so they could use us for their own ends.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Wait, that's right! Speaking of ends... Could Paimon say one other thing?

response.speaker: Ningguang
response.text: Of course.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Paimon's heard that anyone who sends a greeting gift gets a little something in return... So, does that include us?

response.speaker: Player
response.text: Seriously, Paimon? Seriously?

response.speaker: Ningguang
response.text: Hmm-hmm, It's alright. I like direct people.

response.speaker: Ningguang
response.text: Well, we have made quite a bit of trouble for you recently. How about this? You can pick any one object here as you please, and you may take it with you.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Yay! Paimon was just waiting for you to say that! Let's see, what should we get...

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: One of the <color=#00E1FFFF>sheets</color> on that wall!

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Don't look at Paimon like that! One of these sheets of paper will sell for crazy prices, even if it's only as large as Paimon's fingernail!

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Just imagine... how much Mora a whole, untorn sheet would sell for!

choices.text: I'd go with Keqing and her skepticism of the divine.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Huh? Well that was an easy search. The biggest sheet is right up there in the most obvious spot. Let's go with that one!

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: La la-la la-la... Let's see what's written on it.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Huh? There's a place marked with a circle on here. Ooh, could it be treasure!? Whatever it is, it better make us filthy rich! Let's see what's written over here...

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: "Sigil..." "of Permission..." Something, something... "Fatui..." "research..." "copy..." Huh?

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Aw, that doesn't sound like treasure at all.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: This piece of paper shows that a Qixing spy discovered traces of classified Fatui research on the <color=#00E1FFFF>Sigil of Permission</color>.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Oh, Ningguang did say that the Fatui have been up to all kinds of mischief in the shadows of Liyue... Spreading rumors, wanting to get their hands on the archon's body, and what not.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: But research on the Sigil of Permission? Paimon wonders what they're up to.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: #Speaking of which, there's also some connection between you and the Sigil of Permission, {NICKNAME}. Seems there's still more for us to find out.

choices.text: It's all unfolding a little too perfectly.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Oh? You really think so?

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Well... should we not go, then?

response.speaker: Player
response.text: No, what I mean is...

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Oh, so you're saying that it's precisely because we can't completely trust Ningguang that we should confirm the truth of what she says for ourselves.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Hmm... That's way out of Paimon's league, Paimon thinks she's been nothing but good to us!

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Anyway, we'll see if you're on to something.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Um, before we look for Zhongli at Dihua Marsh, let's go to the place marked out on these papers and see if the Fatui really are up to no good there.

choices.text: Ningguang is clearly trying to steer us there.

dialogues.speaker: Xingxi
dialogues.text: Thanks for saving Uncle Meng. Please take care.

dialogues.speaker: Xingxi
dialogues.text: Well, now... time to clean that pot...

dialogues.speaker: Ningguang
dialogues.text: So, have you made your choice?

dialogues.speaker: Ningguang
dialogues.text: You don't have to confirm it with me. Just choose one and take it.

dialogues.speaker: Ningguang
dialogues.text: Afterwards, why not sit down for a while in the Jade Chamber, or have a short stroll? Rest is also an integral part of any journey.

response.speaker: Ningguang
response.text: Come now, there's no need to stand on ceremony. Loosen up a little.

choices.text: It's time we made a move. See you...

response.speaker: Ningguang
response.text: Alright then. I hope the next time we meet, you will either have already done the right thing... or, will be about to make the right call.
